notes:
{置|お}き{換|か}える is an ichidan transitive verb meaning to replace, substitute, or rephrase. The basic pattern is A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}える (to replace A with B).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Intransitive form: ⟦{置|お}き{換|か}わる→置き換わる：30074_okikawaru⟧ (to be replaced)

ASPECT (ている):
{置|お}き{換|か}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "has replaced" or "is replacing" depending on context.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}える: to replace A with B
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}える: to put into words
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}える: to rephrase in other words
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}えて⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think about it as if it were yourself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}える→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧: to swap, exchange (physical objects)
- ⟦{取|と}り{替|か}える→取り替える：01252_torikaeru⟧: to exchange, replace (items)
- ⟦{言|い}い{換|か}える→言い換える：04595_iikaeru⟧: to rephrase (speaking only)
